assets.design_note: 年輕的見習士候選人，身著銀藍色學院制服，手持全息數據板，展現探索未知的求知氣息。藍白配色象徵科技與純淨。
assets.gen_prompt: young male cadet in academy uniform, blue and silver trim, short hair, holding a holographic datapad, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 女見習士穿著鑲金邊的學院服，束著高馬尾，手持水晶杖，散發堅毅而溫和的初學者光芒。藍金配色顯出潛力與領袖氣質。
assets.gen_prompt: young female cadet in academy uniform, blue and gold trim, ponytail, carrying a staff with crystal tip, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 溫柔的引導者，粉白長袍與飄逸長髮，手捧淡金光球，象徵溫暖與指引。柔和色調營造安心感。
assets.gen_prompt: gentle female guardian, soft pink and white robes, holding a glowing orb, kind smile, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 務實的守護者，褐色夾克與工具腰帶，手檢全息設計圖，展現踏實的工程師風格。大地色系強調可靠。
assets.gen_prompt: practical male guardian, brown jacket, tool belt, inspecting a holographic blueprint, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 嚴肅正式的黑衣軍官，肩章星徽與冷峻眼神，透露不可逾越的紀律。暗色金屬質感帶出權威。
assets.gen_prompt: strict male guardian in dark military uniform, stern expression, shoulder pads with star emblem, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 理性分析家，銀色緊身衣外罩實驗袍，眼鏡與腕部電腦顯示邏輯至上。銀灰主調搭配冷藍光。
assets.gen_prompt: rational female guardian with glasses, lab coat over silver bodysuit, analyzing data on wrist computer, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 自由奔放的比喻藝術家，彩色流動長裙印有星雲圖案，手持畫筆法杖，色彩奔放象徵創造力。
assets.gen_prompt: free-spirited female guardian, colorful flowing dress with cosmic patterns, holding a paintbrush-like wand, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 深沉哲人，深藍長袍綴星座刺繡，兜帽遮頭，懷抱古書卷，氛圍神秘靜謐。群青色與銀星點綴。
assets.gen_prompt: deep philosopher male guardian, dark blue robe with star constellations, hooded, holding an ancient tome, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 詩意感性的守護者，白紫漸層禮服，周圍飄浮光點，長髮如銀河傾瀉，夢幻空靈。
assets.gen_prompt: poetic female guardian, ethereal white and lavender dress, aura of light particles, long flowing hair, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 活力教練，橙白輕甲與運動頭帶，握拳蓄能，傳遞行動與能量。暖色系展現熱血與激勵。
assets.gen_prompt: energetic male guardian, sporty armor in orange and white, punching pose with energy fists, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 博學的議會智者，高大紫金長袍，周身環繞全息卷軸，多臂或光屏展示多元知識。紫金配色彰顯智慧與威嚴。
assets.gen_prompt: wise council guardian, tall figure in majestic gold and purple robes, multiple holographic scrolls floating around, pixel RPG sprite

assets.design_note: 象徵災難性遺忘的怪物，形似半溶解的書頁怪，每當玩家學習新技能時會侵蝕舊記憶。擊敗它可獲得記憶穩定道具。
assets.gen_prompt: A monster made of dissolving book pages, glowing faintly with lost knowledge. Pipoya-style pixel art, sad expression, dark purple and gray palette.

assets.design_note: 外表像過度裝飾的數據雕塑，身上貼滿訓練標籤但忽略真實規律。攻擊時會複製玩家的招式但不理解弱點。
assets.gen_prompt: A creature covered in tangled data charts and labels, chaotic and cluttered. Pipoya monster style, messy design, bright neon green and pink.

assets.design_note: 梯度消失的化身，半透明、幾乎隱形的霧狀幽靈，在暗處行動能讓玩家技能失效。需要高學習率道具方能偵測。
assets.gen_prompt: A translucent ghost fading into the background, barely visible. Pipoya monster, ethereal and spooky, pale blue and white gradient.

assets.design_note: 梯度爆炸的具象，不穩定且隨時可能爆發的元素生物，體表不斷閃爍高能色彩。過量攻擊會觸發自爆連鎖。
assets.gen_prompt: An unstable elemental creature crackling with energy, glowing in bursts. Pipoya style, explosive red and orange colors, dynamic pose.

assets.design_note: 學習率震盪的生物，形似彈性膠質，不停在兩個位置間來回跳動且難以擊中。擊倒後掉落學習調整藥水。
assets.gen_prompt: A bouncy slime monster oscillating between two positions, blur effect. Pipoya monster, jelly-like with motion lines, yellow and teal.

assets.design_note: 訓練資料偏差形成的巨石像，只暴露於部分特徵而忽略整體。攻擊選擇性極強，脆弱的反面屬性可致勝。
assets.gen_prompt: A massive stone golem carved with skewed data patterns, one-sided design. Pipoya monster, asymmetrical and imposing, brown and dark gray.

assets.design_note: 散發柔和藍光的晶體，使用後可暫時穩固知識記憶，防止遺忘。所有冒險者背包常備之物。
assets.gen_prompt: A glowing blue crystal with memory runes, pixel art icon style. Simple yet elegant, sharp facets, beautiful cyan luminescence.

assets.design_note: 將注意力凝聚於沙漏之中，使用後一小時內專注力倍增，技能冷卻時間減半。
assets.gen_prompt: A magical hourglass with swirling golden sand that never falls, icon item style. Time-focus artifact, warm amber and gold colors.

assets.design_note: 灌入梯度流能量的玻璃瓶，喝完能重新活化神經連結，讓技能升級變得容易。
assets.gen_prompt: A potion bottle filled with flowing gradient liquid from blue to red. Icon item style, swirling liquid inside, glossy glass.

assets.design_note: 記載泛化理論的魔法書，閱讀後能暫時降低過擬合風險，使玩家技能可以對抗未知敵人。
assets.gen_prompt: An open spellbook with pages showing generalizing patterns, not overfitting. Pixel art icon, tome with mystical symbols, gold trim.

assets.design_note: 鑲嵌於裝備的微型晶片，注入學習動量，提升整體訓練效率。工程師的最愛。
assets.gen_prompt: A futuristic microchip with glowing circuits, enhancing learning speed. Icon item style, tiny but powerful, neon green traces.

assets.design_note: 校正資料偏差的魔法天秤，使用後平衡訓練集，消除偏見巨像的影響。
assets.gen_prompt: A balance scale with perfectly aligned data orbs on each side. Icon item style, elegant and harmonious, soft white and gold.

assets.design_note: 結合記憶鞏固術式的護盾，佩戴期間免疫遺忘魔的攻擊，保持知識清晰。
assets.gen_prompt: A round shield etched with brainwave patterns, defensive aura. Icon item style, sturdy and reliable, silver and sapphire.

assets.design_note: 封存突破性靈感的火花石，使用後可跳脫局部最優，發現新的解決路徑。
assets.gen_prompt: A spark of inspiration captured in a crystal, bursting with ideas. Icon item style, vibrant orange and yellow sparks, creative energy.

assets.design_note: 新手初始草原，遍布簡單標記的訓練石與輕柔微風。適合熟悉基本操作。
assets.gen_prompt: Top-down pixel art grassland tiles for RPG. Simple beginner plains with training stones, soft green grass, sunny sky vibe. 512x512.

assets.design_note: 資訊密集的迷宮森林，樹木枝葉皆記錄著資料流向，小徑充滿預處理挑戰。
assets.gen_prompt: Top-down RPG forest tiles with data streams flowing through trees. Pixel art, dense woods with digital patterns, mysterious atmosphere.

assets.design_note: 高維度城市，建築物模仿神經元結構，傳送門連結不同層級，是訓練與推理的主場。
assets.gen_prompt: Top-down futuristic city tiles resembling neural network nodes and connections. Sci-fi pixel art, glowing synapses, starry background.

assets.design_note: 充滿高維度雜訊的深淵，環境不斷變形，僅有強韌模型才能抵達底層的終極考驗場。
assets.gen_prompt: Top-down abyss tiles with chaotic data noise, deep purple and black. Pixel art, dizzying patterns, glowing red edges, dangerous feel.
